svg.title: Field and equipotential lines between two metal plates
svg.desc: Plate A on the left is positive at 100 V and plate B on the right is negative at 0 V. Blue field lines run straight across from A to B, evenly spaced, and bow outward at the ends. Green equipotential lines at 75 V, 50 V and 25 V are straight, evenly spaced, and parallel to the plates, crossing the field lines at right angles. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: The imposed probe first moves along a vertical equipotential, then along the field. V falls from 75
to 25 V and electric work rises to +50 μJ.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
